note: Documented track state for the new tracks: surface and layout changes with a source. Used to decide which seasons of lap data describe the track as it is now. First batch, 2026-11-11; not complete.

laguna-seca.change: Full resurfacing, done right after the 2023 IMSA weekend; first IMSA race on the new surface in May 2024
laguna-seca.effect: Use laps from 2024 on. Laps up to 2023 are the old surface

mid-ohio.change: New surface on the 2.258-mile course, first raced by IMSA series in June 2024

detroit.change: IMSA races on a downtown street circuit since 2023; Belle Isle was used 2007–2022
detroit.effect: Belle Isle laps and Belle Isle sim tracks do not describe the current circuit

daytona.change: Described as an older surface in 2024
daytona.effect: No break in the lap data found

sebring.change: Described as an older surface in 2024
sebring.effect: No break in the lap data found

long-beach.change: Described as an older surface in 2024
long-beach.effect: No break in the lap data found

road-atlanta.change: Partial or full repave within the decade before 2024 (year not stated in the source)
road-atlanta.effect: Year to be found before splitting the data

watkins-glen.change: Partial or full repave within the decade before 2024 (year not stated in the source)
watkins-glen.effect: Year to be found before splitting the data

vir.change: Partial or full repave within the decade before 2024 (year not stated in the source)
vir.effect: Year to be found before splitting the data

le-mans.change: Mulsanne Straight resurfaced from the Daytona Chicane to Mulsanne Corner; work began 21 July 2025
le-mans.effect: The 2026 race is the first on the new surface there: 2025 and 2026 laps are not the same track state

le-mans.change: Lap length 13.626 km since the Porsche Curves work for 2018 (three metres shorter)
le-mans.effect: Matches the FIA length used for the acceptance check

le-mans.change: Start line moved 145 metres in March 2018
le-mans.effect: Start position for sector and lap alignment

suzuka.change: West Course closed for resurfacing ahead of the 2026 Grand Prix
suzuka.effect: Existing simulator track; 2026 laps are on a partly new surface
